Lithium ion batteryTechnical field

The utility model is related to a kind of lithium ion battery.

Background technology

At present, in existing lithium ion battery, in order to allow positive plate and negative plate to separate, covered typically all on negative plate Insulated spacing collar is provided with, then insulated spacing collar is fixed in core by high-temp glue, but high-temp glue long period of soaking is in electrolyte Easily insulated spacing collar is departed from from core, cause negative electrode lug to be contacted with the aluminum hull or anode ear of lithium ion battery and short circuit shows As potential safety hazard is big.

Utility model content
